dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: None; lateral margins exhibit smooth, continuous curvature without visible bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform medium slate-grey to blue-grey pixel intensity across the visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low; the dorsal area displays a homogeneous textural phase with no visible localized dark-pixel clusters or mottling.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; no sharp gradient slopes are visible between pigmented and depigmented regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Limited to small, high-intensity specular highlights near the blowhole and along the right dorsal-lateral margin, consistent with water droplets; no structural lesions or rake marks visible.

other_distinctive_markers: Clearly defined elliptical blowhole orifice at the anterior and a prominent longitudinal dorsal ridge extending toward the posterior terminus.
